title: Reports: Month/Year selectors for Monthly report type

requirements.summary: On Reports > Report Configuration, replace the Monthly report’s day-based date selection with explicit Month and Year selectors that drive the existing start/end date range and printing.
acceptanceCriteria: When Report Type = "Monthly", the UI shows a clear Month selector and Year selector (English labels).
Changing Month/Year updates the computed startDate/endDate used for filtering revenue/expenses/COGS totals to the selected calendar month.
The page’s "Financial Summary - … to …" header reflects the selected month’s date range.
The "Print Report" action prints the report for the currently selected month/year without requiring the user to manually pick a specific day.

file_operations.description: Create a small, reusable Month+Year selector composed from existing shadcn/ui Select components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Expose controlled props (month, year, onMonthChange, onYearChange) and render English labels or allow caller-provided labels. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update Report Configuration so that when Report Type is Monthly, the date input is replaced by the MonthYearSelector (Month + Year). Ensure the selected month/year drives the existing startDate/endDate computation (calendar month start through month end) and that the Financial Summary header and Print Report use the currently selected month/year-derived range. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Keep non-monthly report type behavior intact and make date-related inputs consistent and understandable for each report type.
acceptanceCriteria: Daily reports still allow selecting an exact date.
3 Months / 6 Months still compute ranges relative to the user-selected reference date (or an equivalent clearly labeled reference control).
Annual reports still allow selecting a year (either via the existing date input or a dedicated year selector), and the computed range remains Jan 1 through Dec 31 of that year.

file_operations.description: Create a simple Year selector composed from existing shadcn/ui Select components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui), suitable for Annual report configuration. Provide controlled props (year, onChange) and English labeling support. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust the Report Configuration inputs per report type: Daily keeps an exact date input; 3 Months/6 Months keep a date input but relabel it to an English, clearer meaning (e.g., "Reference Date") while preserving existing range logic; Annual uses the new YearSelector (or an equivalent clear control) and keeps the computed range as Jan 1–Dec 31 for the selected year. Ensure UI remains consistent across type switches without altering report calculations beyond the derived start/end range. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
